title: The variety of group actions on all algebraic real hyperbolic spaces
summary: For a cardinal $κ$, denote by $\mathbf{H}^κ$ the algebraic real hyperbolic space of dimension $κ$. For a topological group $Γ$, we study the set of continuous representations $Γ\to \operatorname{Isom}(\mathbf{H}^κ)$ up to continuous self-representations $\operatorname{Isom}(\mathbf{H}^κ)\to \operatorname{Isom}(\mathbf{H}^κ)$. The novelty of this work relies in considering simultaneously all cardinals, finite or infinite.
